facts.value: Tests, in exact first-true order: ftCo_Catch_CheckInput, ftCo_SpecialS_CheckInput, ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput, ftCo_800D6824, ftCo_800D68C0, ftCo_AttackS4_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackHi4_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackLw4_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackS3_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackHi3_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackLw3_CheckInput, ftCo_Attack1_CheckInput, ftCo_80091A4C, ftCo_800DE9D8, ftCo_Jump_CheckInput, ftCo_Dash_CheckInput, ftCo_800D5FB0, and ft_8008A244. Only if all return false does it call ftWalkCommon_800DFEC8 with ftCo_Walk_Enter. The shared helper synchronously invokes that callback only when the speed-selected walking motion differs, passing a cycle-phase-derived, integer-truncated starting frame; it does not retain the callback.

Classification, base-relative entry, and animation-rate consumption.

facts.rationale: Correct base-versus-selected-state ambiguity and parameter consumption without asserting compiled member contiguity.
facts.value: Ordinary input entry tests facing-relative stick through ftWalkCommon_800DFC70; the Ottotto variant first applies teeter_walk_threshold. Both supply 0.0F to Enter on success. Enter derives accel_mul by unity initialization, optional metal replacement, optional non-unit vertical scaling, and optional x197C factor in that order. It reads anim_vars[0..2] through a pointer initialized to &fp->x2DC and forwards these values, unchanged arg8, slow_walk_max, mid_walk_point, fast_walk_min, and accel_mul to ftWalkCommon_800DFCA4. The three walking attributes are consumed as animation-rate parameters. WalkSlow is the supplied motion base; the initializer selects base plus a ground-speed-derived walk type. Anim, Phys, and Coll forward the fighter object to their respective shared helpers.

evidence.why: Input guards, modifier branches, and continuation delegation.

facts.rationale: Replace the always-WalkSlow wording and distinguish fresh input entry from walking-type re-entry.
facts.value: Successful ordinary walking input enters a speed-selected Walk motion at frame zero. Ottotto input additionally requires the inclusive teeter threshold before testing the inclusive ordinary walking threshold. Entry computes its modifier in metal, vertical-scale, then x197C order and delegates with WalkSlow as a base rather than an always-selected motion. All three walking motions share this TU's Anim, IASA, Phys, and Coll callbacks. IASA stops at its first true transition predicate; otherwise the shared walking helper may synchronously re-enter through Enter with a phase-derived starting frame when the selected walking type changes.
